title: [CertiK｜提示级｜OTA-09][audit-fix] 资产准入无法保证 U/Q 始终符合转账与余额假设
description:
## 来源与修复范围

来源：[CertiK TSV 初审报告（原始 PDF）](https://gitlab.okg.com/web3-dex/tsv/uploads/4b71892b28b1a3f8a9851a862d66ee15/CertiK-PRE-OKX-TSV---Audit__preliminary-20261030T231203Z.pdf)，第 35,36 页，编号 **OTA-09**，原报告等级 **Informational**。原报告状态为 Pending；以下状态是 2026-10-31 独立代码复核结论，不代表 CertiK 已确认关闭。

**修复目标分支：`audit/2026-10-27-6402443-fix`（audit-fix）。请本项单独提交修复/验证记录，建立对应 MR，不与其他审计项混成一个不可独立验收的变更。**

- 报告审计 commit：`85623cd73ab6248b4acec71f478f30088c4deec3`。
- audit-fix 复核 commit：`543dcd34e882eead3a9f2391540c704105fbc693`。
- main 对照 commit：`a8bfc93aa2cf40142e6511e5069d90f65b59f420`；本 Issue 的修复目标是 audit-fix。

## 双基线复核

- **audit-fix：仍依赖外部准入约束**
- **main：仍依赖外部准入约束**

成立，且实际影响取决于准入资产；不能因为报告标为 Informational 就认为不兼容资产可以安全使用。

### 原因与实现

结算和 W 储备模型依赖实际转账精确、raw balance 不隐式重基、Q 收款不被接收方自行拒绝。手续费、额外扣款、负重基会破坏名义金额与储备；正重基可能制造 OTA-04 的无归属余额。LP 可控的 Q 接收拒绝会让强退回滚，NFT/tickCount 恢复，阻碍下市。

### 影响与利用前提

这是一组外部代币兼容性/升级风险，需要实际代币具备相关行为才触发。UI multiplier 变化与 raw balance rebase 必须区分：前者在 raw 余额不变时可正常支持，后者会改变储备关系。报告没有证明当前所有已部署 U/Q 一定违规，本次也未逐一查询链上代币实现。

## audit-fix 处理要求与验收条件

- [ ] 提交可执行的 U/Q 准入检查清单和资产登记记录：无手续费/额外扣款、无 raw balance rebase、固定 decimals、Q 不允许接收方可控拒收；区分 UI multiplier 与 raw balance rebase。
- [ ] 明确外部代币的升级权限、变更监控、复核及暂停/迁移流程；不可用一次试转或 decimals 探测声称永久满足这些性质。
- [ ] 以不兼容代币用例验证储备/交付假设和拒绝准入流程；若产品必须支持不兼容资产，另提供结算/托管设计，不能仅用注释关闭风险。
- [ ] 在本 Issue 记录最终处理、对应 MR/完整 commit、验证命令与结果，并提供供 CertiK 复核的证据；已修复项以复核和回归补全验收，不制造无意义的重复代码改动。

### 修复建议及注意事项

完善准入清单：无转账税/额外扣款、无 raw balance rebase、decimals 固定、Q 无接收方可控拒收；审查代理升级权与发行方升级流程并持续复核。一次试转或 decimals 检查不能保证未来行为。若必须支持不兼容代币，需要调整计量/储备或强退托管交付模型，属于独立设计工作。

## 已有验证与边界

静态调用链复核；未执行该项动态攻击 PoC。

本次为报告逐项复核，未发送生产交易；mock 边界测试不代表完整端到端攻击或现网资产/角色配置已经确认。

## 报告原文

```text
[PDF page 35]
OTA-09     OKX TSV - AUDIT


OTA-09               Admission Does Not Guarantee That U/Q Meet Documented
                     Transfer Assumptions




 Category                  Severity                       Location                                                                Status


 Inconsistency                  Informational             core/TSVRegistryV1.sol: 415~437, 446~454                                    Pending


  Description

Documentation requires operators to verify that live U/Q             transfer     /  transferFrom       are exact, fee-free, and free of rebase
or implicit balance changes, and to review upgrade, pause, blacklist, and receiver-rejection behavior. On-chain registration
does not enforce those properties.

If admitted U/Q violate the documented conditions, or later change via upgrade, pause, or blacklist:

1. Fees / short delivery.       _unwrap     burns the full W amount and transfers the same nominal U. A fee-on-transfer or short-
   delivery token credits the recipient (C < N); the token’s fee or burn logic absorbs the difference. PoolManager and W
   supply already decrease by (N), and           TSVSwapRouterV1        records that nominal amount as          actualOut     . On the inbound
   path the transfer amount is (N) and the adapter receives (C).              wrapToPoolManager(N)           mints against idle adapter U
   ( U.balance − W.totalSupply            ). When idle funds cover (N-C), it still mints full W and settles the debt, consuming shared
   surplus for the shortfall. Insufficient idle U reverts the wrap.


2. Extra payer debit. Some tokens debit the payer (N+\mathrm{fee}) while crediting the payee only (N). When quote is paid
   into PoolManager and the credit equals the requested amount,                  settle     closes the debt,    unlock     succeeds, and the
   extra payer debit is not refunded. A short quote credit leaves PoolManager underfunded; the residual delta cannot clear,
   so   unlock     reverts and increase or swap fails. Quote has no adapter surplus to cover a shortfall, so an under-credit to
   the vault leaves an open delta.


3. Negative rebase / transferless deflation. Rebase or deflation rewrites balances without a                       transfer    ; W supply does
   not move with them. Once adapter (U < W.\mathrm{totalSupply}), the checked subtraction in                         wrapToPoolManager
   underflows and later wraps fail. An unwrap that requests more U than remains reverts the                      take    at  safeTransfer      . After
   quote in PoolManager shrinks,          take    / TAKE_PAIR      still withdraw the nominal amount. A withdrawal that fits in the
   remaining reserve can succeed and further drain the vault; a withdrawal above the remaining reserve reverts immediately.
   Once the reserve is exhausted, remaining positions cannot exit. A positive rebase likewise leaves unattributed surplus
   outside LP accounting.


4. Receiver rejection. Forced exit delivers withdrawn assets to the LP. A rejecting contract, blacklist, or paused transfer fails
   delivery.   unwindPositionByTsv          burns the position in one      unlock     and   TAKE_PAIR     s both pool currencies to the LP; W
   unwraps to U on transfer, and Q is sent as ERC-20. A failed Q transfer reverts the                   unlock    and restores the NFT.

     unwindPosition       mints ERC-6909 first, then delivers the real assets to the LP. Q is not a permissions adapter,

     _getOwner     is zero, and there is no issuer fallback, so failure reverts         UnAcceptableScenario         . The revert restores the
   NFT and      tickCount     . DELIST     requires    tickCount == 0      ;  delistSecurity        requires   listedPoolCount == 0          . A last
   undeliverable position therefore blocks pool and security delisting.

[PDF page 36]
OTA-09      OKX TSV - AUDIT




Source NatSpec (issue #6, item 4) and             PERMISSIONED_REGISTRY_V1.md             already mark this as off-chain admission that the
chain cannot fully enforce.


  Recommendation

Operators should verify that listed and candidate U/Q tokens use exact, fee-free transfers, do not rebase or otherwise
change balances implicitly, and cannot reject delivery based on the recipient. These checks should be repeated after token
upgrades, blacklist-policy changes, pauses or other administrative changes that may affect transfer and balance semantics.

Registration does not enforce these properties. Tokens that violate them can cause settlement failures, consume unattributed
backing, create accounting discrepancies, prevent asset redemption or block forced exits and subsequent pool and security
delisting.

If quote tokens with recipient-dependent transfer restrictions must be supported, implement a forced-exit fallback that
preserves the LP’s entitlement without requiring immediate delivery to the LP.
```
